mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte wasting, which can reduce penicillin clearance and increase toxicity risk; both agents can cause hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (potassium, magnesium), and penicillin levels closely; adjust penicillin dosing based on creatinine clearance; consider alternative antifungal if possible.
